subject: Staged close plan & MAP — pricing options tied to checkpoints
messages:
From: Emma Caldwell <emma.c@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procure@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Staged close plan & MAP — next steps

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is pushing to get a staged close plan in place so we can route approvals — target PO date is the week of Oct 4 (internal legal needs a week). To make that work we need: a) a mutual action plan with checkpoint acceptance criteria, b) pricing tied to ramp milestones, and c) the evaluation plan (metrics we’ll use during pilot).

Can you send an updated MAP and two pricing options we can show to our CFO: (1) conservative pilot ramp (3m, low commit), (2) 6m ramp with higher committed throughput (discount tiers). If you have a version that ties discounts to MAP checkpoints (e.g., 25% at pilot completion, 35% at validated ramp), that would help speed approvals.

Security team still needs the SOC 2 evidence but they said the outstanding items can be tech addenda post-PO if the commercial is agreed.

Short timeline on our side: internal finance needs numbers by Sep 30 to include in Oct 8 procurement run.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Emma
Director, Platform Integrations
Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_initial_map_v2.pdf (referenced)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Caldwell <emma.c@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged close plan & MAP — pricing options tied to checkpoints

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear timeline. Attaching an updated MAP (Acme_MAP_v3.pdf) and a pricing worksheet (pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx) that maps three scenarios to checkpoint milestones:

- Pilot (90d): no commit, 15% trial discount, acceptance = functional parity & latency SLO met on sample workload
- Ramp (6m): committed monthly token tiers, 25% discount after checkpoint 2 (30-day performance review), 35% at checkpoint 3 (full production ramp)
- Enterprise (annual): committed capacity + reserved pools, steeper discounts and a short-term credit for onboarding if they sign within 30 days of SOW

Callouts: discounts are conditional on the MAP acceptance criteria (test prompts + latency/quality checks). We can also add an interim credit instead of an upfront discount for the pilot if accounting prefers credits tied to milestone invoice triggers.

Question for you: what monthly token range should I tie the Ramp tier to? I guessed 200M tokens/month in the attached sheet — if your forecast is different, I’ll rerun the modeling.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v3.pdf, pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged close plan & MAP — pricing options tied to checkpoints

Hannah / Ben — reviewed the MAP and pricing_sheet_v2. Quick notes:

- I’m comfortable with the 25%/35% checkpoint structure but prefer replacing the "onboarding credit" with milestone-based invoice credits (easier for revenue recognition).
- Pull back the 30-day performance review to 45 days after checkpoint 2 — gives us more time to collect eval telemetry on their higher token mix.
- If Acme wants a deeper discount for an immediate start, we can offer a short-term signing concession (one-time credit) in exchange for a 12-month committed minimum.

Approve moving to commercial with those edits. Hannah, can you incorporate and re-send? Ben, loop finance only if they push for a change to contract language.

-Rishi
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround on timelines. We can commit to the MAP v3 with a couple of commercial clarifications:

1) Pricing: Ramp scenario updated to reflect 225M tokens/month baseline. Checkpoint discounts will be applied as invoice credits upon acceptance: 25% credit after checkpoint 2 (45-day review), 35% credit after checkpoint 3 (production ramp).
2) Onboarding: one-time onboarding credit available if Acme signs the SOW and PO by Oct 12. That credit will be applied as a contra-invoice on month 2.
3) Acceptance: evaluation criteria attached (pilot success checklist) — acceptance is sign-off by Acme product + our CS after the checkpoint telemetry window.

I’ve included the DocuSign link for the MAP/SOW bundle and the HubSpot deal record in case legal wants to review. Once you sign, we will provision a sandbox API key and schedule the checkpoint calls with CS.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/sign?doc=acme_map_v3

If this sounds good, send the PO and we’ll kick off onboarding immediately.

Best,
